name: Video360
notes: Imported from Figma. Colours are baked in, so the accent picker stays off until the artwork is tokenised. Outline is derived from the Standard artwork by luminance: paper knocks out, ink is the body. Filled is the inverse of the same classification, so the plate is solid and the marks cut out of it.
